summary: To make content reusable and shareable, use roles, which keep playbook content self-contained and work well with Git submodules.
questions: What's the best way to share Ansible content between projects?

answer_card.title: Make content reusable with roles
answer_card.answer_md: Package content as **roles** (and ideally collections). Roles are self-contained and easy to share via Git (e.g. submodules) or Galaxy.
